name: Booming Blade
description: Make a melee weapon attack against a creature within reach; it takes thunder damage if it willingly moves before the start of your next turn.
dmg roll: weapon damage; +1d8 thunder if target moves
higher_spellslot_benefit: At 5th, 11th, and 17th level: +1d8, +2d8, +3d8 thunder on hit, and movement damage becomes 2d8, 3d8, 4d8.
